notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {1}.
Lesser Masticore dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, triggering Remnant of the Rising Star, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

uses.name: Jugan Defends the Temple // Remnant of the Rising Star
